source_title: Office of the Registrar: Audit a Course
section_heading: Courses that may not be audited
text: Auditing lets a student observe a course without earning credit. Computer Science and Engineering courses cannot be audited. The Registrar also excludes online and hybrid courses and courses that charge a lab fee.

source_title: Office of the Registrar: Audit a Course
section_heading: How to apply to audit an eligible course
text: For an eligible course, check availability and obtain the instructor approval by university email. Submit the application and approval to the Registrar by the full-term census day.
